items.question: What documents do I need for tax filing in Pakistan?
items.answer: For individual tax filing, you'll need your CNIC, salary slips or income proof, bank statements, previous year's tax returns (if applicable), and details of any investments or property. For businesses, additional documents include business registration certificates, financial statements, and expense receipts. Our team will provide a complete checklist based on your specific situation.

items.question: Can you help with FBR registration online?
items.answer: Yes! We handle complete FBR registration including NTN registration, sales tax registration, and income tax registration. Our team manages the entire online process through the FBR's IRIS portal, ensuring all documentation is correct and submitted on time. We also provide post-registration support for any FBR queries.

items.question: What's the deadline for income tax returns in Pakistan?
items.answer: The standard deadline for filing income tax returns in Pakistan is September 30th for salaried individuals and December 31st for businesses and non-salaried individuals. However, deadlines may vary based on your taxpayer category. We recommend filing early to avoid last-minute rush and potential penalties.
